body:
Invalid or missing language headers could fall through to Core1 parsing in public `check`, normal `simulate` and source-only `inspect`. This six-path integration propagates the existing header error before profile dispatch, preserving its diagnostic code, message and UTF-8 offset. Supported Core1/Core2 routes retain their existing behavior.

Local offline Cargo validation passed all nine selected command phases and 18 Rust tests, covering the three header routes, preserved source-check cases, public capability routing, existing Core1/Core2 controls and the library header diagnostic. The receipts bind 878 source pins to candidate `829f4456`.

These are finite source/CLI observations. Earlier review adoptions apply to their original candidates; they do not establish adoption of this integration. Full language and financial behavior, compiler Artifact/Target, native, proof and ledger acceptance remain open. This consolidates #244, #248 and #249; close those delivery PRs only after this PR actually merges into main. Preserve their branches/history and the separate 33-path financial work.

Root verified the complete six-path change, all 878 committed source pins and the actual local results. Fresh whole source/result reviews returned qualified approval; their unsupported extra consumer and control-coverage claims are rejected. Validation is limited to the written test assertions and captured primary header outputs.
title: Preserve Core profile errors across public source commands
